answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Following previous work, we evaluate our LSMGA-based model with the task of tail entity prediction. Concretely, we rank all entities in the candidate set to predict t given h and r for each triple (h, r, t) in the test set. Then three common evaluation metrics are reported, i.e. Hits@1, Hits@10 and mean reciprocal ranks (MRR).
